name: @pipeworx/mcp-japan-places

tools.name: places_near_station
tools.description: Find facilities in Japan near a named train or subway station — convenience stores (konbini: 7-Eleven, Lawson, FamilyMart), restaurants, pharmacies, hospitals, ATMs, banks, hotels, supermarkets near a Shinkansen, JR, subway or private-railway station. Answers "convenience stores within 500m of Shibuya station", "pharmacies near Shinjuku station", "hospitals near Namba station". Geocodes the station name within Japan, then searches OpenStreetMap around it. Returns each place's name, category, distance in metres and coordinates.

station.description: Station or place name, e.g. "Shibuya Station", "Shinjuku Station, Tokyo", "Namba Station, Osaka". Adding the city helps disambiguate common names.

category.description: What to find: "convenience_store", "station" (another station nearby), "hospital", "pharmacy", "restaurant", "cafe", "supermarket", "bank", "atm", "hotel", "post_office", "toilet", "parking", "temple", "shrine", "park" — or an exact OSM tag like "shop=bakery".

tools.name: places_near_point
tools.description: Find facilities in Japan near a latitude/longitude — convenience stores, stations, hospitals, pharmacies, restaurants, ATMs and other POIs. Use when you already have coordinates rather than a station name. Answers "what's within 300m of 35.6595,139.7005 in Tokyo" style questions. Returns each place's name, category, distance in metres and coordinates, sourced from OpenStreetMap.

category.description: What to find: "convenience_store", "station", "hospital", "pharmacy", "restaurant", "cafe", "supermarket", "bank", "atm", "hotel", "post_office", "toilet", "parking", "temple", "shrine", "park" — or an exact OSM tag like "shop=bakery".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-japan-places forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the japan-places pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
